name: Warning message
description: Persistent context about consequences or risks before someone continues.
sourceBasis: Source-based recreation of the page-authored warning banner in the Designer app's content-import confirmation modal (modules/projects/components/runtime-content/import/kb-import-confirmation-modal.component.html:14), reviewed against Designer checkout 753c84252b on 2026-09-08. Not a Figma extraction; there is no figmaLink.

props.name: Warning message
props.description: A fixed banner in Review Content Import, displayed when breakingCount is nonzero. It has no component props, size enum, title slot, or dismissal input.

props.name: content
props.description: In the site's rendered recreation the body is projected content; the reference banner has fixed text.

props.name: width
props.description: Exposed by the shared rendered component (width 100% or fit-content, max-width 100%, min-width 0). The Warning message page only shows fill; width follows the caller's panel.

documentationPreviewControls.name: preview width
documentationPreviewControls.note: Narrow caps the documentation canvas at 320px. It changes only the canvas, not the component.

content.name: Plain
content.description: Body text only. Reference copy: "These keys are referenced by build query criteria and will be removed. Affected builds will fail until resolved."

content.name: Emphasis
content.description: Same body with the key consequence in bold: "Affected builds will **fail** until resolved." Bold emphasis is a documentation recommendation, not in the source template.

content.name: Wrapping
content.description: The reference body inside a 260px-wide column; text wraps to multiple lines with the icon staying at the top.

width.name: Full panel
width.description: Fills the available panel or column. Example copy: "Settings are not configured, some functionality may be missing."

width.name: Half-width column
width.description: The same message in a half-width column; the message follows the column width.

variations.title: None. There is no title slot. The Breaking Changes heading belongs to the surrounding section, outside the message.
variations.action: None inside the message. The Import Anyway confirmation action belongs to the surrounding modal.
variations.dismiss: None. The baseline has no timer or close control.

observedAppVariations.name: Breaking changes reference
observedAppVariations.difference: Orange 50 fill, 1px Orange 100 border, 8px radius, 12px padding and 8px gap. Neutral 600 text at 12px / 16px, regular. Top-aligned 16px Orange 500 warning icon. The Breaking Changes heading is outside the banner.

observedAppVariations.name: Settings and operation warnings
observedAppVariations.difference: Same orange fill, border and icon, but 8px padding, centered alignment and Neutral 500 text. Used in MS Graph, database, MCP, file storage and test-operation screens. Width follows the caller's panel.

observedAppVariations.name: Email settings corners
observedAppVariations.difference: Uses 12px corners instead of 8px, with the 8px-padded settings treatment and half-width placement.

observedAppVariations.name: Dataset and capture warnings
observedAppVariations.difference: The dataset dialog uses 8px padding; its capture menu counterpart uses 4px. Both use 12px / 16px Neutral 500 text, centered alignment, an 8px radius and Orange 100 border.

observedAppVariations.name: API-key reset warning
observedAppVariations.difference: 12px padding with 14px / 20px Neutral 700 text and a warning icon offset down 2px. The template sets a border color but no border width, so it does not have the import banner's visible 1px border. Reset API Key is outside the callout.

observedAppVariations.name: Migration warning
observedAppVariations.difference: Uses a stronger Orange 500 border, 8px padding, centered icon alignment and 12px text. This is a local difference, not an approved higher-severity variant.

observedAppVariations.name: React provider warning
observedAppVariations.difference: Uses a 0.5px Orange 100 border, 14px horizontal / 8px vertical padding, a 10px gap, and 12px Neutral 900 text. The icon is centered.

variations.note: Observed app variations are caller differences in Designer, not a supported variant API. Only the documented baseline is the design-system reference.

statesNote: Static message with no interactive states.
sizesNote: No size axis. The site shows a single style reference; placement width is not a size variant.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Pale orange surface with 12px padding, 8px corners, and a subtle 1px border. Horizontal flex row, children aligned to the top (flex-start), 8px gap.

anatomy.name: IconSlot
anatomy.description: Fixed 16x16 alignment slot; flex, centered both ways, does not shrink.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: Outlined orange warning triangle (Phosphor Warning, regular weight), 16x16, aligned to the start of the content, aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: Body
anatomy.description: Consequence or risk at 12px / 16px. Wraps without truncation (overflow-wrap anywhere, min-width 0). The baseline keeps headings and confirmation actions outside. Other app compositions include grouped messages or inline navigation.

documentationSurface.note: The site previews the Warning message on a neutrals-50 surface.

placement.relativeTo: Above the content affected by the consequence, before the person continues; keep it visible while that consequence applies. State the consequence before asking people to continue.
placement.width: Follow the containing column: fill the available panel or column. Placement width is not a size variant.
placement.outsideTheMessage: Section headings (Breaking Changes) and confirmation actions (Import Anyway) belong to the surrounding modal or section, not inside the message.
placement.notForFieldHelp: Keep field-specific instructions and validation with their control. Use a callout for context affecting a section or task.

useCase.title: Explain the consequence
useCase.description: Say what will happen and what will be affected before people continue.

do.title: Emphasize the key risk
do.description: Bold only the essential consequence. Keep the rest easy to scan.

do.title: Let longer messages wrap
do.description: Keep the baseline icon at the top and show the full message without truncation.

do.title: Follow the containing column
do.description: Fill the available panel or column. Placement width is not a size variant.

sharedBase.note: Defined on the shared inline-message base spec. The Warning message page itself renders only the items above.

do.title: Keep context beside the affected content
do.description: Place an Info tip beside the settings it explains and a warning above the content affected by the consequence.

do.title: Keep essential information visible
do.description: Leave the message available while its condition applies. A brief toast cannot replace persistent guidance.

dont.title: Do not infer one universal style
dont.description: The shared Info tip and the page-authored warning have different spacing and typography. Similar-looking call sites also contain local variations.

dont.title: Do not promote field help into a banner
dont.description: Keep field-specific instructions and validation with their control. Use a callout for context affecting a section or task.

considerations: The reference is page-authored markup in the import modal. It has no shared variant or size API.
The Breaking Changes heading and Import Anyway action belong to the surrounding modal, outside the message.
State the consequence before asking people to continue. Keep the warning visible while that consequence applies.
The baseline has no timer or close control.

accessibility.role: Static context needs no live role. Announce dynamic feedback according to urgency.
keyboard: Tab: keep interactive links and controls in the normal reading order.
Focus: do not move focus merely because a result appears.
aria: aria-hidden: decorative icons are hidden; the text carries the meaning.
aria-describedby: associate a message with an affected control when appropriate.
aria-live: the source template declares no live region. If an important result changes dynamically, its caller must provide appropriate announcement behavior.

gaps: No dark-mode treatment is defined. The rendered component uses the same palette tokens in both themes and globals.css does not redefine --flowx palette variables under .dark, so colors.dark simply repeats colors.light.
No title element exists (no title slot), so title typography and color are undefined.
No link or action color is defined for the Warning message; the reference banner contains no inline action and the spec defines no Action element (unlike the Info message's blue-500 action).
The bold emphasis is a plain <strong> element; no numeric font weight is specified for it in the sources, and bold emphasis is a documentation recommendation rather than part of the source template.
No hover, focus, or pressed behavior is defined because the message has no interactive parts.
No Figma source exists for this component; values come from the Designer app source and the site's rendered recreation.
The spec and the rendered component agree on every value; the warning has no decision log entries.
